entities.name: Eva Turnová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eva Turnová is a Czech singer, songwriter, bass guitarist, teacher, translator and actress. Since 2001 she was a member of The Plastic People of the Universe. She left the band in 2015. Between 1995 and 2001 she was a member of DG 307. Her first husband was Czech actor David Matásek. In 2008, she released her first solo album called Eturnity.
